# Rowby

> Count rows without losing your place.

Rowby: Crochet Row Counter — Knitting row counter & ruler. iPhone app, available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815129271?pt=128839649&ct=ai_web

## Guides

- [How to Count Rounds and Repeats When Making Amigurumi](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/rowby-app/how-to-count-rounds-and-repeats-for-amigurumi): Count amigurumi rounds, increases and repeats without arithmetic: linked repeat counters, targets and row reminders on iPhone.
- [How to Count Rows While Crocheting on iPhone (Best Row Counter App)](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/rowby-app/how-to-count-rows-while-crocheting-on-iphone): The easiest way to count crochet rows on iPhone: a big tap pad, a ruler that follows your pattern, and hands-free voice counting. Honest comparison with other row counter apps.
- [How to Keep Your Place in a Crochet or Knitting Pattern PDF on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/rowby-app/keep-your-place-in-a-crochet-pattern-pdf-on-iphone): Stop losing your row in a PDF pattern: put the pattern and a counter on one screen, with a ruler that moves down the page. Steps, FAQ and an honest app comparison.
- [knitCompanion Alternatives for iPhone: Cheaper Row Counter Apps](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/rowby-app/knitcompanion-alternative-for-iphone): Looking for a cheaper alternative to knitCompanion on iPhone? Honest comparison of StitchTally, Stitch Keeper, Rowby and knitCompanion: prices, sync, pattern tools.
- [Voice-Controlled Row Counter for Knitting and Crochet on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/rowby-app/voice-controlled-row-counter-for-knitting-and-crochet): Count rows hands-free while knitting or crocheting: say next, back or undo. How voice counting works on iPhone, what it needs, and how Rowby compares.
